exposure: Participation in the Adequate Birth Project (PPA)
participation in the Adequate Birth Project (PPA)
outcome: Respectful treatment during labor and birth
Satisfaction with care of the baby
cohort: 2348 postpartum women who desired vaginal birth at the end of pregnancy, recruited from 12 private hospitals participating in the Adequate Birth Project (PPA) in Brazil
finding: Among women who had a vaginal birth, participation in the PPA was associated with a more positive birth experience, while this association was not observed for women who had a cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that the effect of PPA participation on birth experience differed by mode of delivery, with a positive association observed for vaginal births but not for cesarean births.
